answer: Continuous physical-presence logging. Each identity must submit periodic sensor readings from a fixed device whose clock drifts against a quartz reference, and an operator cannot fake distinct drift signatures for many devices without buying many. A dune-side relay station co-signs each reading with its own drift, binding identity to one physical location. Attackers pay full hardware and site cost per sybil, while a knoll-based auditor cross-checks drift consistency across stations.
